$comment: vibe shipped injection defaults. A project overrides ANY of this from a root vibe.json — same shape, merged over these values (channels.<c>.blocks replaces, .add/.remove edit, blocks.<id> patches or defines a block, blocks.<id>.enabled=false silences one). Never edit this file in an install; it is replaced on upgrade.

user-prompt.level.$comment: LEVEL cadence — every turn, byte-stable by construction. Two lines is the ceiling: this is the only payload that pays prompt-cache rent on every single turn, so it carries the cursor and its transition command and nothing else.

user-prompt.edge.$comment: EDGE cadence — only on the turn after the flow cursor moves (tracked in .vibe/last-inject). This channel CARRIES the orders: when it is configured the inject hook stops emitting them separately, which is the whole point of classing the payload.

user-prompt.event.$comment: EVENT cadence — only on a turn that carried an event (a drift nudge or queued warnings). Empty by default: add blocks here that are worth saying WHEN something happened and worth nothing when nothing did.

user-prompt.$comment: Standing rules, LEVEL cadence (the default for any channel that declares no trigger): injected on EVERY turn (UserPromptSubmit), after the flow's own level and edge channels. Keep it byte-stable and tiny — it lands in the transcript once per turn and pays prompt-cache rent forever.

session-start.$comment: Injected once per session (SessionStart, +compact), after the flow doctrine. Timeless rules only — this output replays stale on --resume, so nothing live belongs here.

agents-md.$comment: Rendered into the AGENTS.md managed rules block by `vibe render agents-md --write`. Prose the model must DECIDE with, that no hook can enforce.

write.note: _Managed by vibe — rendered from the `agents-md` channel by `vibe render agents-md --write`. Edit the blocks or `vibe.json`, not this region._
